name: VAT on construction services under the VAT Law
name_zh: 建筑服务增值税：增值税法下的一般计税与简易计税
review_status: Drawn from the published statutes and announcements named below. Pending review by a Chinese cost engineer (造价工程师) and a tax adviser before it is relied on for a tender. The 预缴 rates rest on a secondary reading and are marked unverified.
references: 中华人民共和国增值税法 (2024-12-25, in force 2026-01-01) Art.10, Art.11
增值税法实施条例 (国务院令第826号, in force 2026-01-01) Art.16, Art.36-38, Art.45
财政部 税务总局公告2026年第10号
财政部 税务总局公告2026年第13号
财政部 税务总局公告2026年第14号 (secondary reading, verify)
国家税务总局公告2024年第11号 (数电票)
historical_references: 财税〔2016〕36号 营业税改征增值税试点实施办法 (replaced by the VAT Law from 2026-01-01)
财政部 税务总局 海关总署公告2019年第39号 (rate history)
住建部办公厅〔2016〕4号 建筑业营改增计价依据调整 (tax-exclusive pricing)
description: A Chinese bill is priced tax-exclusive and the VAT is added as its own head. Under GB/T 50500-2024 that head is the fourth (增值税); under GB 50500-2013 it is the fifth (税金), after 规费. The rate follows the contract and the method the project elected, so a contractor can run both methods on different jobs at the same time.

methods.name: general method
methods.basis: output VAT on the tax-exclusive works cost, with input VAT credited
methods.applies_to: construction services in general; goods sold with installation are 13 from 2026-01-01, other services 6

methods.name: simplified method
methods.basis: a collection rate on gross receipts divided by 1.03, with no input credit
methods.applies_to: labour-only contracts (清包工) and old projects (老项目, permit start before 2016-04-30) until 2027-12-31; employer-supplied works (甲供工程) only where the project elected before 2026-01-01

prepayment.formula: (gross receipts - subcontract payments) / (1 + rate) x prepayment rate
prepayment.carry_forward: a negative base prepays nothing and the shortfall is deducted next period

practice_notes: The 9 percent figure is the rate since 2019-04-01. It was 11 percent from 2016 and 10 percent from 2018-05-01, so an older bill is not wrong for carrying a different number
Every rate in the other heads already excludes VAT; applying the rate to a tax-inclusive base overstates the total
专业工程暂估价 is priced VAT-inclusive and stays out of the VAT base
A simplified-method election is kept for 36 months
A 甲供 material line is priced in the bill and in the VAT base, and is deducted on the payment application rather than invoiced
